description: Typer / Click framework pack: CLI command callbacks and groups are entry points resolved by the framework, never by imports.
notes: A function decorated with @app.command() / @click.command() is a CLI entry point even though nothing in the repo imports it. Same for @app.callback() (the Typer callback) and Click groups. Tutorial scripts (docs_src/**/tutorial*.py) are standalone entry points whose main() is a decorated command.
